title: Cell Migration Boundary Motion in Drosophila Egg Chambers: A Combined Phase Field and Chemoattractant Model
summary: In the Drosophila melanogaster egg chamber, the collective migration of border cells toward the oocyte is guided by spatial gradients of chemoattractants. While cellular responses to these cues are well characterized, the spatial distribution of chemoattractant within the tissue remains difficult to measure experimentally due to imaging limitations and extracellular complexity. In this study, we develop a spatially resolved mathematical framework to model local chemoattractant concentrations during border cell migration.
